ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobe regions bounded by 35% low-intensity black pixels along the margins and transverse streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous white regions on both lobes; thick black margins along the trailing edge (pixels y-max) and leading edge (pixels y-min); multiple high-contrast linear black streaks crossing the white regions at various angles.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 8% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with medium-frequency peaks and varying pixel amplitudes (3-10 pixels) along the trailing boundary, most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges transitioning to sharp, slightly tapered distal tips with a mild upward curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small yellowish-brown pixel clusters (3-5 pixels diameter) localized near the median notch and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral patches, including a prominent set of parallel vertical marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake mark scarring across the central white surface; possible parasitic lesions or barnacle remnants near the central notch area.
